calls.statement:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.start_date, c.end_date, c.channels, c.holdout_pct, c.mailing_list_size, c.holdout_size,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS rows_h,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS distinct_h
FROM dim_campaign c WHERE campaign_name ILIKE '%black%' OR campaign_name ILIKE '%week%' ORDER BY start_date

calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
exp AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS holdout,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM exp) AS targeted,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h JOIN exp USING(member_id)) AS overlap,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) AS not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM h UNION ALL SELECT member_id FROM exp)) AS union_ct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) AS exp_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=15) AS stg_rows

calls.statement:
SELECT c.campaign_id, c.campaign_name, c.mailing_list_size, c.holdout_size, round(100.0*c.holdout_size/c.mailing_list_size,2) AS pct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout h WHERE h.campaign_id=c.campaign_id) AS rows_h,
 b.holdout_size AS bak_holdout, b.mailing_list_size AS bak_list
FROM dim_campaign c LEFT JOIN bak_dim_campaign_2025 b USING(campaign_id) ORDER BY c.campaign_id
